sloka: द्रक्ष्यस्यद्यैव कैकेयि पशुव्याLअमृगद्विजान् ।गच्छतः सह रामेण पादपाम्श्च तदुन्मुखान् ॥२-३७-३३॥
transliteration: drakṣyasyadyaiva kaikeyi paśuvyāLamṛgadvijān ।gacchataḥ saha rāmeṇa pādapāmśca tadunmukhān ॥2-37-33॥

translations.english: Today you shall see, O Kaikeyi, flocks of cattle, elephants, deer and birds following Rama, even the trees bending towards him.
